stories.headline: Energy Transfer Just Raised Its Distribution for the 20th Straight Quarter. Here's How Much $10,000 Invested Pays Annually.
stories.body: Key PointsFor the 20th quarter in a row, Energy Transfer has increased its quarterly distribution. With this increase, the pipeline MLP now sports around a 7% forward yield.

stories.headline: Citi shooter was enraged over Best Buy credit-card debt suit
stories.body: After receiving a court summons over $2,500 in delinquent debt, an Orlando, Florida, man shot and killed a Citi employee at the bank's Tampa campus, according to police.

stories.headline: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
stories.body: Coreweave's steep yields reflect stress in the AI debt markets as investors worry about a data center slowdown. What comes next.
